# Epigraph {.unnumbered .unlisted .oculto}

::: {.epigrafe}
“A superior pilot uses his superior judgment to avoid situations which require the use of his superior skill.”

 — Frank Borman, commander of the Apollo 8 mission and USAF fighter pilot.
:::
